titulo: O salmo que Jesus gritou na cruz
gancho_tela: Jesus gritou um salmo na cruz
estilo_imagem: cinematic photorealistic epic film still, dramatic volumetric god rays, floating dust particles, deep chiaroscuro, first century Judea, muted earthy tones, vertical 9:16
prefixo_video: Cinematic epic film shot, slow and subtle motion.
epoca_imagem: First century Judea, Jerusalem around 30 AD, limestone city walls, rocky hill outside the gate, olive trees, stone, wood, clay and cloth only, nothing modern

cenas.trecho: Fora dos muros de Jerusalém, ao meio-dia, Jesus está na cruz, e trevas cobrem a terra.
cenas.prompt_imagem: wide high aerial view of a rocky hill outside the limestone walls of first century Jerusalem, three tiny distant wooden crosses on the hilltop, black clouds swallowing the midday sun
cenas.prompt_movimento: dark clouds roll slowly over the sun, the light fades, slow aerial camera glide toward the hill

cenas.trecho: Por três horas, até a hora nona, o céu não clareou.
cenas.prompt_imagem: wide view of the stone rooftops and walls of first century Jerusalem under a heavy dark sky at midday, a few oil lamps glowing in small windows, dust in the air
cenas.prompt_movimento: heavy clouds drift slowly, lamp flames flicker in the windows, dust floats, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Então Jesus gritou em alta voz: Eli, Eli, lamá sabactâni?
cenas.prompt_imagem: low-angle view from the rocky ground up toward the top of a rough wooden cross against a dark stormy sky, a single thin beam of pale light breaking through the clouds
cenas.prompt_movimento: storm clouds churn slowly, the thin beam of light trembles, wind blows dust across the rocks, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Quer dizer: Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste?
cenas.prompt_imagem: vast dark sky over a desolate rocky hill, three tiny distant wooden crosses as small shapes on the horizon, a faint crack of light in the clouds
cenas.prompt_movimento: clouds move slowly, the faint light flickers in the sky, slow camera pull-back

cenas.trecho: Alguns ali pensaram que ele chamava Elias. Mas aquelas palavras eram muito mais antigas.
cenas.prompt_imagem: an ancient parchment scroll partly unrolled on a rough stone ledge, Hebrew letters in dark ink, a clay oil lamp beside it, dim warm light in a dark stone room
cenas.prompt_movimento: the lamp flame flickers, warm light dances over the letters, dust floats, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Era a primeira linha do Salmo vinte e dois, escrito por Davi cerca de mil anos antes.
cenas.prompt_imagem: an old wooden lyre resting against a stone wall in an ancient Israelite palace room at dusk, a clay lamp and a rolled scroll on a wooden table, golden light through a small window
cenas.prompt_movimento: golden dusk light shifts slowly through the window, the lamp flame flickers, dust floats in the beam

cenas.trecho: O mesmo salmo diz: traspassaram-me as mãos e os pés.
cenas.prompt_imagem: close-up of three rough iron nails and a wooden mallet lying on dark rocky ground at the foot of a wooden beam, grey storm light
cenas.prompt_movimento: wind blows dust slowly across the stones, grey light flickers, very slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: E também: repartem as minhas vestes, e sobre a minha túnica deitam sortes.
cenas.prompt_imagem: a seamless woven linen tunic folded on a flat rock, small ancient bone dice scattered beside it, dark rocky ground, dim stormy light
cenas.prompt_movimento: the cloth edges ripple in the wind, dust drifts across the rock, slow camera descent

cenas.trecho: Aos pés da cruz, os soldados fizeram exatamente isso.
cenas.prompt_imagem: high-angle view of the foot of a rough wooden cross on a rocky hill, a few tiny figures far away in the distance crouched in a small circle on the ground, dark sky, dust in the air
cenas.prompt_movimento: dust swirls slowly in the wind, dark clouds drift, slow camera descent from above

cenas.trecho: Mas o salmo termina dizendo que Deus ouviu o seu clamor. Mateus, capítulo vinte e sete.
cenas.prompt_imagem: wide view of a rocky hill outside first century Jerusalem, the dark clouds parting, a great beam of golden heavenly light falling over three tiny distant wooden crosses
cenas.prompt_movimento: the clouds part slowly, the golden beam of light grows brighter, dust sparkles, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Quando faltar palavra na sua dor, ore a Palavra. Deus escuta. Siga para mais.
cenas.prompt_imagem: an ancient open scroll on a stone ledge lit by a soft beam of morning light, olive branches outside a small window, first century Judea
cenas.prompt_movimento: morning light grows softly over the scroll, olive leaves move in the breeze, slow camera pull-back

legenda:
Senhor, quando faltar palavra, que eu ore a tua Palavra 🙏✝️
Mateus 27:46 · Salmo 22:1
Comente "Amém" se você crê que Deus ouve o seu clamor.
